sentences.text: The South Australian Independent Commission Against Corruption reported on prevention recommendations sent to public authorities during the 2021/2022 financial year.
Its 15 letters covered conflicts of interest, supervision and workplace culture, and controls for activities with higher corruption risks.
The Commissioner identified undeclared or unmanaged conflicts as relevant to many investigations and discussed them in more than half the letters.
The Commission concluded that authorities had substantial opportunities to reduce corruption risks through stronger policies, practices and procedures.

items.quote: The observations and recommendations made by the Commissioner suggest that there are significant opportunities for many public authorities to strengthen their practices, policies and procedures to reduce corruption risks.
